mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.medication_id AS medicationId, NVL(m.item_name, '복약') AS name, NVL(s.category, 'prescription') AS type, TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time, TO_CHAR(s.taken_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS takenAt, NVL(s.alarm_enabled, 1) AS alarmEnabled FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(s.scheduled_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.taken_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.scheduled_at ASC
